newsitem.title: USA: Enron unit files for 8.0 mln preferred.
newsitem.headline: Enron unit files for 8.0 mln preferred.

text.p: Enron Capital Trust I, a business trust formed by Enron Corp, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 8.0 million trust preferred securities.
Proceeds will be invested by the trust in partnership preferred securities of Enron Preferred Funding L.P., in which Enron Corp is general partner.
The partnership will in turn use the funds to invest in debentures of Enron Corp and certain U.S. government obligations and commercial paper of entities not affiliated with Enron Corp.
The registration also covers $200 million in subordinated debentures of Enron Corp.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co.
